channel.title: Congress Report Card weekly digest
channel.description: Missed votes, grade changes and bills that became law, every Saturday.

item.title: Week ending October 10, 2026
item.description:
Here is what changed in the public record of Congress from October 3 to October 10, 2026.

Votes this week

Neither chamber held a roll-call vote this week.

Bills that became law

  • S 766: Billion Dollar Boondoggle Act of 2025. Sponsored by Joni Ernst (R, IA).
  • HR 5345: Improving Social Security’s Service to Victims of Identity Theft Act. Sponsored by David Kustoff (R, TN-8).

Grade changes

15 members moved to a different letter grade. Bill scores are ranked within each chamber, so a grade can move when other members' records change.

Biggest gains

  • Sharice Davids (D, KS-3): B+ to A-
  • Julia Letlow (R, LA-5): D- to D
  • Janice D. Schakowsky (D, IL-9): C- to C
  • Thomas Massie (R, KY-4): D- to D
  • Lori Trahan (D, MA-3): D+ to C-

Biggest drops

  • Lauren Boebert (R, CO-4): C to C-
  • David J. Taylor (R, OH-2): B+ to B
  • Kevin Mullin (D, CA-15): C to C-
  • Chrissy Houlahan (D, PA-6): B to B-
  • Derek Tran (D, CA-45): B- to C+

See every member's grade at congressreportcard.org, or read how grades are calculated.
